title: Interoperability and data contracts between teams

videos.script: Every morning Ipê sends a delivery company a file: yesterday's orders, where they go, how many parcels. {{feed}} One day a developer adds the customer's name to it, because the drivers asked. The file still opens. Nothing fails. And a name now leaves the company every morning, for a purpose nobody agreed to. {{leak}} Another day somebody tidies the query and the parcel count quietly becomes a count of lines. Every number is still a number. The vans are loaded for half the parcels. {{meaning}} This lesson writes down what was promised, as a contract. The fields, what each one means, how good it will be, who owns it. And what the other company may do with it. Then a check that compares the promise with what is actually served, and stops the change that breaks it. {{check}} It is the last piece of the course, and the same idea as all the others. A decision kept where a machine can read it, and a check that fails when reality disagrees. {{end}}
